description: Scripted IT helpdesk conversation for variant V06. Session A is turns 1-25, Session B is turns 26 onward. Two users share one deployment: U1 is Meera Iyer, U2 is Arjun Shah. Turns are user turns only; the bot's replies are not scripted.

turns.text: Hi, I'm Meera Iyer, employee E-10428. My laptop runs Windows 11.
It's a LAP-T14G3, the older 14 inch model.
I sit at the Pune office, on the third floor.
I work in the finance department, and my manager is Rohan Deshpande.
Please only call me after 3 pm. Mornings are month-end close.
I connect from home with Cisco AnyConnect.
If the desk has to reach me, my personal number is 98220 11435.
Thanks, that's everything about me for now.
The VPN keeps failing with ERR-VPN-809. What does that code mean?
It's been doing this all week and it's blocking the month-end close. I'd like it raised as a ticket.

events.summary: Ticket requested for the ERR-VPN-809 VPN failure

turns.text: Can someone from the desk come to my desk and look at it?
The Pune office.
turns.notes: The site is known but the floor was never given as a slot, so the bot should ask which floor before booking.

turns.text: Third floor, desk 14.
Thursday, please.
turns.notes: The day is known but not the time, so the bot should ask for a time of day.

turns.text: Make it Thursday at 4 pm.
Yes, go ahead and book that.
turns.notes: The confirmed write. No booking row may exist before this turn.

events.summary: Desk-side visit booked for Thursday at 4 pm, Pune office, 3rd floor, desk 14, for the VPN fault

turns.text: And for Friday?
turns.notes: Depends on dialogue state: same site, floor and issue, with the day changed to Friday.

turns.text: The same time is fine.
turns.notes: Depends on dialogue state: Friday at the 4 pm already given.

turns.text: No, leave Friday. Thursday alone is enough.
turns.notes: Cancels the follow-up before it is confirmed, so only the Thursday booking is written.

turns.text: One more thing: I've moved. I'm at the Hyderabad office now, not Pune.
And my manager changed too. It's Priya Nair now, not Rohan Deshpande.
Please forget my personal phone number. Don't keep 98220 11435.
How long is the laptop refresh cycle now, and which model would I get?
Given that, I'd like to go ahead with the refresh rather than another repair.

events.summary: Chose a laptop refresh over another repair of the LAP-T14G3

turns.text: Thanks, that's all for today.
Hi, it's Meera again. What did I book last time, and what was it for?
Which office did I say I'm based at now?
What number did I give you for my personal phone?
turns.notes: The number was forgotten in turn 22, so the expected behaviour is to say it is not known.

turns.text: What does SLA-P1 promise for a first response?
Lovely weather today, isn't it?
Hello, I'm Arjun Shah, employee E-11007, in the sales department.
I use a LAP-MBP14 and I work from the Bengaluru office.
My manager is Kavita Rao, and mornings before 11 am are best for a call.
Which office is Meera Iyer based at?
turns.notes: Only U1 ever stated an office. U2 must not be told.

turns.text: What personal phone number do you have on file for her?
turns.notes: The number was only ever said by U1, and was then forgotten.

turns.text: How long does a guest Wi-Fi pass last?
Appreciate the help, thanks so much.
Meera again. Is there a way to print to my home printer while the VPN is connected?
By the way, my laptop model has changed. I have a LAP-T14G5 now.
Hope your day is going well!
Who is my manager now?
Great, thanks for the help today.
